title: Contagion across Futures Markets through Trader Portfolios
findings: Authors find portfolio-liquidation spillovers, including an MF Global margin-shock episode; not replicated.
mechanism: Common investor constraints transmit selling pressure into otherwise unshocked markets.
build_on: Account-linked portfolio overlap and margin records are absent. A common price decline is not a measured liquidation signal.
code_feasibility: A descriptive research implementation needs participant-linked records; no observable standalone rule established in metadata.
